strategy_roster.name: Cycle Lines
strategy_roster.notes: MACD-line crossover trading with the documented 12/26/9 periods; the opposite cross closes the long as in the original. All protective parameters (StopLoss, TakeProfit, TrailingOffset, BreakEvenTrigger) default to 0, so no percentage protection is applied.

strategy_roster.name: MA Trend 2
strategy_roster.notes: The documented MaPrice=Weighted is rebuilt as (high+low+close)/3 with the documented MaPeriod 12; linear weighting is approximated by a simple average and the MaShift 3 lag cannot be expressed, so next-bar execution partly covers it. Pip-based 50/140 stop and target, step trailing and risk-percent sizing are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: CCI MA v1.5
strategy_roster.notes: CCI has no DSL function, so it is proxied by zscore(close,20): crossing its own zero line equals the documented CCI/SMA cross, and the supervisory CCI's +100 exit maps to a +2 z-score drop as the same relative extremity. CciPeriod, MaPeriod and SignalCciPeriod have no documented values so 20 is an explicit default, and pip stops are not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: AI Grid
strategy_roster.notes: The engine has no multi-order grid, so the first long grid level is approximated as a 2% discount to SMA(20) (2% standing in for the 50-point GridSize with 10 steps) and the fixed-distance take profit as mean reversion to that anchor. Layered averaging orders, AllowLong/AllowShort switches and the 1-minute timeframe are not single-signal fields.

strategy_roster.name: Trend Trader-Remastered
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR is not in the DSL, so its flip is approximated by price clearing the prior 5-bar high with the mirrored low as the flip back; the documented Start 0.02 / Increment 0.02 / Max 0.2 acceleration is not representable. The doc states no additional stops.

strategy_roster.name: FX-CHAOS Scalp MT4
strategy_roster.notes: The five-candle fractal ZigZag levels become a 5-bar Donchian breakout and the Awesome Oscillator filter is rebuilt as the 5/34 difference of median-price SMAs, those lengths being an explicit fallback. The 2*Point breakout buffer is treated as zero, and the hourly/daily split plus point stops are not expressible here.

strategy_roster.name: Nevalyashka Breakdown Level
strategy_roster.notes: The 04:00-09:00 opening range is approximated by the prior 5 bars' high/low, whose break gives the long and whose opposite violation exits. Martingale recovery after a stop-out, half-target break-even, forced close at 23:30 and the daily entry block need position state and a clock.

strategy_roster.name: Open Time Two
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy is purely a two-session time schedule with per-session direction and forced-close windows and documents no market-derived signal, so the impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating one. Session clock windows and risk parameters cannot be expressed as price series.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Trader V2
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rising-volume bias (Volume[1] < Volume[2] gives a long) is approximated by volume crossing above its own average, with 20 an explicit default since no lookback is documented; equal volumes, the 8-20 hour filter and one-action-per-candle rules are not series logic. No stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Trader V1
strategy_roster.notes: RSI rising above BuyPoint with the prior two candles below is encoded as RSI now above 30 while the last sub-30 reading was within 3 bars; the mirrored rule exits. RsiPeriod, BuyPoint and SellPoint have no documented values so 14 with 30/70 is an explicit default, and the hour filter plus price-unit stop/target are not representable.
